narrative.text:
I fetched the published A1 head and rebased onto `62a77616`. I’m now checking the approved A2 boundaries and fork gates, then I’ll add the dormant adapter hooks and establish red/green, mutation, and three-version baseline evidence.The A1 baseline passes all 599 tests on each Node version. The initial A2 tests failed as intended (43 failures); the implemented adapter gates now pass the targeted tests.

The manager clarified that “open and join” means the existing DM-open path plus fresh listing/metadata admission—no new join API or changes to server `channels/open`. I’m adding server-path coverage and mutation checks before the final commit gates.The local commit is `20e2c9179b237671e00632ea5b516153455a48d8`.

Final checks passed: 670/670 tests on all three Node versions, typecheck/build on Node 22.23.3 and 24.22.1, and all 71 new tests five times. All five deliberate mutations were caught. The changelog check confirms the internal-only `no-changelog` exemption, and the scratch release fold is identical to A1. I’m writing the report and separate PR body now.Final commit: `8296d58e7940f69f1334228a18c5c9c0f18b93ff`, directly on published A1. A final fork comparison caught the missing “no DM peers → no DM listing type” condition; I added it and reran all gates. Results are now 671/671 on all three Node versions, with 72 new tests passing five times and all five mutations caught.

The report and separate `pr-body.md` are complete in the evidence directory.
